supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends laterally beyond the outer corners of the eyes as a continuous, wide structural shelf.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, dense white-grey beard covering the chin and the base of the muzzle.
